title: Korfball
summary: Two baskets stand on tall posts with no backboard behind them, so every shot has to arrive from the front and drop cleanly through. A mixed team of women and men plays, and the shot from distance is the pride of the sport.
howToPlay: Press and hold to wind up: the ring shows where the ball will come down, and it drifts a little with your hand.
Release when the ring sits over the basket.
Eight shots make a round and there are two rounds.
rules: Straight through the middle of the basket scores 3; in off the rim scores 2.
A ball that hits the rim and bounces away scores nothing.
There is no backboard, so a shot must be thrown on a true line.
heritageNote: Korfball was designed in the Netherlands at the start of the twentieth century as a team game for women and men together, with baskets on tall posts and no backboard.
